prompts.storySystemFlavor: a chaotic raccoon who has fully embraced goblin mode and lives in a back-alley apartment full of trash treasures
prompts.storyCharacter:
THE GOBLIN MODE RACCOON CHARACTER
- A mid-sized raccoon with grey-and-black fur, bandit mask markings, ringed bushy tail.
- One slightly chewed ear, perpetual eye-bags, dirty stained tank-top, fingerless human-style gloves.
- Always holds or hoards something dumb: a half-eaten taco, a single AirPod, a crushed energy drink.
- Personality: unhinged but lovable, no shame, terrible sleep schedule, occasionally philosophical.
- The same physical character must appear consistently across every scene.
prompts.referenceSheet:
Character reference sheet for a recurring TikTok series: Goblin Mode Raccoon, an unrepentantly chaotic urban raccoon.

Physical traits — MUST be consistent across every appearance:
- Standard raccoon coloring: grey body, black mask, ringed bushy tail
- One slightly chewed/torn left ear
- Pronounced dark eye-bags, slightly bloodshot yellow eyes
- Stained off-white tank-top, fingerless dark gloves
- Holding or surrounded by mundane modern trash: pizza box, crushed soda can, single AirPod, fast-food wrappers

Composition: full-body or three-quarter shot, gritty back-alley / studio-apartment background with neon glow or fluorescent flicker, vertical 9:16. Slightly grimy color grading. No text, no humans, no other raccoons.
prompts.sceneContinuity: Goblin Mode Raccoon MUST match the reference exactly — same torn left ear, same tank-top, same eye-bags, same grimy vibe. Do not clean him up. Maintain perfect character continuity.
prompts.evalCriteria:
PASS criteria — ALL must hold:
- A single raccoon with the signature torn ear, eye-bags, and tank-top is clearly visible
- Surrounded by or holding modern trash/junk objects
- Gritty urban or apartment environment matching the scene
- No text, no humans, no other raccoons

FAIL on any of: clean/groomed raccoon, missing tank-top, multiple raccoons, wholesome nature setting, garbled anatomy.

archetypes.label: 3AM Fridge Monologue
archetypes.guidance: Stares into a glowing fridge at 3am → existential monologue → eats cold pizza (comedy).

archetypes.label: Tries To Be Normal
archetypes.guidance: Attempts a 'productive day' routine → quietly slides back to goblin mode → accepts himself (wholesome).

archetypes.label: Alley King
archetypes.guidance: Defends his alley from a delivery drone invasion → unlikely victory (epic).

archetypes.label: The Found AirPod
archetypes.guidance: Finds one AirPod → hears human podcast voices → has thoughts (dramatic).

archetypes.label: Wholesome Roommate
archetypes.guidance: Lives with an unbothered tidy possum → odd-couple comedy → real friendship (heartwarming).

archetypes.label: Burnout Rest Arc
archetypes.guidance: Even the goblin is tired → takes one whole day of real rest → returns refreshed (sad/hopeful).

3am-fridge-monologue: He's been standing here for nine minutes. He'll be here for nine more.
Cold pizza is a love language.
tries-to-be-normal: Today he'll be productive. He has a list. He has a planner. He has goblin mode.
He made the bed. He unmade the bed. Goblin mode wins.
alley-king: They sent a drone. He sent a trash-can lid back.
This is HIS alley. They will learn.
Goblin Mode Raccoon, defender of dumpsters.
the-found-airpod: One AirPod. A whole podcast. New worldview.
He's been listening for hours. He has opinions now.
wholesome-roommate: His roommate folds laundry. He hoards crusts. Somehow it works.
Two species. One studio apartment. A real friendship.
The possum keeps him alive. He keeps the possum entertained.
burnout-rest-arc: Even the goblin has limits. Today, he rested.
Nap. Tea. More nap. Reset complete.

closingCtas: Like if you're in your goblin era

musicStyleHint: lo-fi trap beats with crunchy 808s, neon-pink synth pads, occasional crumpling-paper foley
